title: EDSea 2023 4K Aftermovie (VLOG)
description:
The first ever EDSea cruise festival. Artists such as Afrojack, Seven Lions, Galantis and Slander were a part of a stacked line up. The cruise went from Miami to The Bahamas and back. What an experience and I can't wait to do it again down the road.

Please like and subscribe as we have many more videos to come including videos from EDC Orlando, Defqon and Tomorrowland.
